audit: M9 Phase 2+9 — evidence inventory and credibility verdicts

evidence_categories.VERIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION: software behavior verified vs analytical ground truth
evidence_categories.CALIBRATED_TO_MEASUREMENTS: model built from/reproduces measurement (own calibration — not independent validation)
evidence_categories.INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED: held-out physical comparison with pre-declared tolerance met

subsystems.governing_equations: Newton–Euler: F = m·a, τ = I·ω̇ + ω×(Iω); quaternion attitude kinematics
subsystems.inputs: mass, inertia tensor (assembled from parts), applied forces/torques
subsystems.parameter_sources: mass/inertia from design snapshot parts; gravity g = 9.80665 m/s² (BIPM defined constant)
subsystems.parameter_class: sourced (g: defined constant; mass/inertia: design data)
subsystems.numerical_verification: free fall v(1 s) = g ± 1e-6; principal-axis spin-up ω = τ/I·t; torque-free conservation of energy and |L_world| < 1e-8; RK4 order-4 step-halving; scipy agreement (tests/physics/test_rigid_body.py)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: verification evidence only: analytical identities and the DEFINED standard gravity. Independent PHYSICAL validation of an assembled aircraft (measured trajectories) does not exist yet — M9 rev 2 reclassified this from 'independently validated' per external review
subsystems.uncertainty: numerical: bounded by convergence studies; model-form: flat non-rotating Earth, constant g, rigid body — declared
subsystems.validated_envelope: flat non-rotating Earth, |v| < ~30 m/s, near-Earth altitudes
limitations: no aerodynamic coupling inside the core
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: dynamics errors would corrupt every trajectory prediction

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.parameter_sources: motor masses sourced (MN3508 103 g, P80 III 649 g); other part masses flagged estimates in component files
subsystems.numerical_verification: two-point dumbbell, box formula, multi-part transfer vs hand computation (tests/physics/test_mass_properties.py)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: verification evidence only: mathematical identities. Physical validation requires a measured real assembly (weighed vehicle, measured inertia) — M9 rev 2 reclassified from 'independently validated'
subsystems.uncertainty: driven entirely by part-mass data quality (flagged per part)
subsystems.validated_envelope: rigid assemblies in the design snapshot
limitations: assembly is rigid; no fuel burn
inertia of irregular parts must be supplied (point-mass fallback)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: wrong inertia → wrong attitude dynamics; wrong mass → wrong thrust margins and endurance

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: packages/physics/propulsion/dataset.py — PCHIP interpolation of manufacturer bench tables (MN3508: 2 voltage planes; P80 III: 1 plane, 21 rows)
subsystems.governing_equations: monotone PCHIP through measured (rpm, thrust) knots; NO physics-based generalization (no blade-element model)
subsystems.parameter_sources: T-Motor MN3508 report MN.00011; T-Motor P80 III product page (both row-verified: T/P = published efficiency, P = V·I)
subsystems.numerical_verification: knot read-back exact (M2/M9 benchmarks); monotonicity per plane
subsystems.calibration_data: the manufacturer tables ARE the model (interpolation of calibration data)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: NONE for thrust generalization: reproducing table knots is calibration, not validation; no held-out measurements exist for these motor+prop pairs
subsystems.uncertainty: dataset uncertainty ±3 % (source-stated); interpolation between knots unquantified
subsystems.validated_envelope: MN3508: 2600–5900 rpm, planes 14.8/22.2 V ±15 %; P80 III: 1719–3747 rpm, plane 47.9 V ±15 %; thrust within [table min, max]
limitations: single-plane datasets rely on flagged voltage extrapolation
flat-thrust region (820 gf) makes rpm inversion ill-conditioned
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: thrust overestimate → unrealistic performance verdicts; underestimate → false infeasibility

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: constant k = Q/T per design (rotor_torque_per_thrust); k sourced from the P80 bench torque column at hover (0.0224 N·m/N); MN3508 k=0 in the reference design (manufacturer published no torque column)
subsystems.parameter_sources: P80 III: published torque column (row-verified via C2 motor-eta band); MN3508: no torque published → k unknown
subsystems.parameter_class: sourced for P80 (single-point at hover); unknown for MN3508
subsystems.calibration_data: P80: k at the hover thrust point (single point, not the full curve)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: the k value comes from the manufacturer bench data (calibration data for our own use) — no independent torque measurements
subsystems.uncertainty: ±(variation across the table) — not sampled in UQ
limitations: constant k (true k grows with thrust)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: wrong yaw authority → yaw control divergence in flight

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: P = V·I identity + per-plane PCHIP current(rpm) with fitted voltage-slope correction and power-based floor (declared extrapolation)
subsystems.governing_equations: P_elec = V_bus·I; current(rpm, V) interpolated between measured planes
subsystems.parameter_sources: manufacturer bench tables (row voltages captured for P80 III)
subsystems.numerical_verification: C1 identity to publication rounding (≤0.5 %); plane normalization ≤2 %
subsystems.independent_validation_data: momentum-theory electrical-power prediction vs P80 bench: MAPE 4.46 %, 100 % within ±15 % (WEAK-FORM — priors literature-informed); vs UIUC wind-tunnel power: MAPE 6.4 % (BLIND, genuinely independent)
subsystems.uncertainty: thrust/eta prior bands declared in the blind comparisons
subsystems.validated_envelope: static conditions; voltages within ±15 % of measured planes; rpm within table
limitations: lumped DC model does NOT close (35 % residual — documented finding)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: current/power error → wrong endurance, wrong thermal margins
evidence_categories: INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED (momentum-theory power path vs UIUC wind-tunnel data, MAPE 6.4 % < 15 % declared — validates the estimation METHOD for this prop class, not an assembled drone)

credibility.basis: independent physical evidence within pre-declared tolerance, no relevant unmodeled mechanisms
independent_evidence: UIUC APC SF 10x5 wind-tunnel power: MAPE 6.4 %, 16 points, all within ±15 % (pre-declared)

limitations: no timing/advance effects (the 35 % lumped-DC residual lives here)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: ESC behavior errors distort the motor electrical chain

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: OCV(SOC) PCHIP (community-sourced curve) + single pack R (constant) + coulomb counting (packages/physics/propulsion/battery.py)
subsystems.parameter_sources: OCV shape: community-measured LiPo charts (intofpv/usedbytes); R and capacity: TYPICAL values flagged estimated
subsystems.parameter_class: mixed: OCV shape sourced (community), R/capacity estimated
subsystems.numerical_verification: OCV read-back, sag arithmetic, coulomb counting (unit tests)
subsystems.calibration_data: OCV curve itself came from community measurements (calibration data for the curve; not independent)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: NONE for our specific packs — no measured discharge of the modeled packs
subsystems.uncertainty: capacity ±10 %, R ±50 % sampled in UQ; dominant endurance sensitivity
subsystems.validated_envelope: steady discharge, < ~8 C in the audited designs
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: endurance estimates optimistic (audit: ~10-20 % once derating/thermal are accounted); sag errors → premature/late warnings

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

limitations: hover/flight of multi-rotor layouts carries unquantified interference thrust/power penalties
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: hexa/octa endurance and hover thrust overestimated (typically low-single-digit % at large spacing, larger when discs overlap)

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.validated_envelope: takeoff/landing within ~1 rotor diameter of the ground
limitations: takeoff/landing thrust and power near the ground are wrong by the classic ground-effect factor (up to ~10-20 % at half-rotor height)

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: quadratic drag with single equivalent CdA (packages/physics/aerodynamics/drag.py)
subsystems.parameter_sources: CdA values in designs are UNSOURCED guesses; ρ = ISA sea level (sourced)
subsystems.uncertainty: CdA dominates; hover/vertical phases barely affected (v≈0)
subsystems.validated_envelope: incompressible, constant density, no AOA dependence

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: equivalent constant lateral FORCE over a time window (capstone: 8 m/s on assumed 0.8 m² area ≈ 39 N)
subsystems.uncertainty: frontal area and gust profile assumed
subsystems.validated_envelope: none — the force profile is not a validated wind model
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: gust-rejection verdicts do not transfer to real wind events

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: cascaded PID (position→attitude→rate→mixer) with inertia-derived gains, slew-limited feedforward, derivative filtering, anti-windup
subsystems.governing_equations: standard cascade PID; quaternion attitude; wrench mixer (least squares)
subsystems.inputs: controller state (true or measured), targets, gains
subsystems.parameter_sources: gains derived from assembled mass/inertia; control architecture from standard multirotor practice
subsystems.numerical_verification: hover hold, altitude step, disturbance rejection, 5° roll within ±0.1°, yaw hold, mixer wrench reconstruction, saturation flags (tests)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: NO flight-log validation: no real flight controller telemetry has been compared against these loops
subsystems.uncertainty: perfect state knowledge in audited runs; noise/latency modeled but not measured; sensor bias modeled (M9)
limitations: torque authority now inertia-scaled (M9 finding F4)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: control verdicts do not transfer to real flight controllers

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: Gaussian noise + zero-order-hold latency + constant bias (packages/physics/controller/sensors.py)
subsystems.governing_equations: additive noise per channel; small-angle quaternion noise
subsystems.parameter_sources: typical values declared in tests; NOT measured from real sensors
subsystems.numerical_verification: bias application verified (M9 regression), noise determinism
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: real sensor stacks may behave worse than modeled

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: cantilever bending of circular tube arms: σ = M·c/I, M = F·L (packages/physics/structures/beam.py)
subsystems.inputs: max rotor thrust, arm length, tube OD/ID, material yield
subsystems.parameter_sources: material properties from sourced handbook bands (flagged ±20 %); tube geometry declared in snapshots (not measured)
subsystems.parameter_class: mixed: sourced material bands + declared geometry
subsystems.numerical_verification: bending stress vs hand calculation (M9/M4 tests)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: none — no coupon tests, no load-cell measurements
subsystems.validated_envelope: static bending at the arm root
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: structural margin could be substantially wrong

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: datasheet current/duration rule (I > I_max sustained beyond rated duration → burnout; I > 2×I_max → instantaneous) — NO thermal integration
subsystems.parameter_sources: manufacturer current/duration statements (14 A/180 s; 60 A/180 s)
subsystems.uncertainty: no winding-temperature state exists in the model
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: real motors may burn out earlier or later than modeled

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: declared critical/warning policy over powertrain, structure, ground, attitude, thrust-envelope monitors (packages/physics/scenarios/runner.py)
subsystems.parameter_sources: limits from component data (sourced where available)
subsystems.numerical_verification: motor failure, depleted battery, over-speed, structural overload tests; bias/latency interaction tests (M9)
subsystems.independent_validation_data: verification evidence only: software behavior tested in simulation. Hardware-in-the-loop or real-failure validation does not exist — M9 rev 2 reclassified from 'independently validated'
limitations: detects only the modeled mechanisms (audit lists unmodeled ones)
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: undetected real-world failure modes remain possible

credibility.basis: functions and is verified in software, but no independent physical validation evidence exists yet

subsystems.model: static-hover coulomb drain to the 3.5 V/cell warning through the sourced powertrain chain
subsystems.calibration_data: the current chain is calibrated to bench data; the pack is not
subsystems.independent_validation_data: NO measured endurance of any real aircraft
subsystems.uncertainty: dominated by battery estimates (capacity/R); no C-rate derating modeled
subsystems.validated_envelope: static hover, < 8 C discharge, no temperature effects
subsystems.consequences_if_wrong: mission-endurance decisions unreliable until pack data exists
